exercises.question: Which sentence says how you feel right now?
options: Hoy me siento cansado. [Today I feel tired.]
Hoy soy cansado. [Today I am tired.]
Hoy me sentiré cansado. [Today I will feel tired.]

exercises.english: I advise you to drink more water.
It is important that you sleep well every night.

sentences: Suelo caminar después de cenar. [I usually walk after dinner.]
Así me siento con más energía. [That way I feel more energetic.]
Por eso duermo mejor. [That is why I sleep better.]

exercises.question: Which sentence uses soler correctly?
options: Los domingos solemos comer con la familia. [On Sundays we usually eat with the family.]
Los domingos solimos comer con la familia. [On Sundays we usually eat with the family.]
Los domingos solemos comemos con la familia. [On Sundays we usually eat with the family.]

exercises.sentence: Normalmente __ siete horas, pero eso cambia durante los viajes.
exercises.english: I normally sleep seven hours, but that changes during trips.
One should sleep eight hours every night.

exercises.question: In which sentence does the verb agree with the noun?
options: Se venden frutas en el mercado. [Fruit is sold at the market.]
Se vende frutas en el mercado. [Fruit is sold at the market.]
Se venden una fruta en el mercado. [A piece of fruit is sold at the market.]

exercises.sentence: Esta semana me siento agotado y tengo mucho malestar.
options: This week I feel exhausted and very unwell.
Last week I felt exhausted and very unwell.
This week I feel full of energy and very well.

exercises.sentence: Es importante que bebas agua y que descanses.
options: It is important that you drink water and rest.
It is important that you drank water and rested.
It is important to stop drinking water and resting.

exercises.sentence: Se deben evitar los hábitos que son perjudiciales.
exercises.english: Habits that are harmful should be avoided.

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: Me siento cansado desde hace una semana.

options: Te aconsejo que vayas al médico y que bebas más agua. [I advise you to see the doctor and drink more water.]
Te aconsejo que vas al médico y que bebes más agua. [I advise you to see the doctor and drink more water.]
Te aconsejo que irás al médico y que beberás más agua. [I advise you to see the doctor and drink more water.]

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: ¿Qué se puede hacer para mejorar la salud?

options: Se puede hacer ejercicio y se deben evitar algunos hábitos perjudiciales. [Exercise can be done and some harmful habits should be avoided.]
Se pueden hacer ejercicio y se deben evitar algunos hábitos perjudiciales. [Exercise can be done and some harmful habits should be avoided.]
Se puede haciendo ejercicio y evitar algunos hábitos perjudiciales. [Exercise can be done and some harmful habits should be avoided.]

exercises.question: Which sentence says what you usually do and gives a reason?
options: Suelo caminar todos los días porque me ayuda a dormir mejor. [I usually walk every day because it helps me sleep better.]
Suelo caminaré todos los días porque me ayuda a dormir mejor. [I usually will walk every day because it helps me sleep better.]
Suelo camino todos los días porque me ayuda a dormir mejor. [I usually walk every day because it helps me sleep better.]

exercises.sentence: La falta de sueño puede afectar al __.
exercises.english: Lack of sleep can affect wellbeing.

template.prompt: Tell someone who feels tired to rest more, because lack of sleep can affect wellbeing.
template.answer: Si te sientes cansado, te recomiendo que descanses más porque la falta de sueño puede afectar al bienestar.

template.prompt: Say that you usually walk every day and that it is recommended to sleep well to have a balanced routine.
template.answer: Suelo caminar todos los días y se recomienda dormir bien para tener una rutina equilibrada.
